title: German Speaking Customer Sales Advisor

German Speaking Customer Sales Advisor
- Location: Heanor, Derbyshire ( near to Nottingham and Derby)

We are hiring for a German speaking Customer Sales Advisor on behalf of a successful and growing internatioanl located near to Nottingham and Derby.

The Role

We are hiring for a German speaking Customer Sales Advisor on behalf of a successful and growing international company. As a German Speaking Customer Sales Advisor, you will be responsible for providing professional sales and technical support to customers, ensuring they receive the right products and solutions. You will act as a key point of contact for German speaking customers, helping to resolve enquiries and deliver an excellent customer experience.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing inbound and outbound customer communications in German and English
- Advising customers on parts, services and technical solutions
- Providing product recommendations and identifying sales opportunities
- Responding to enquiries via telephone, email and live chat
- Processing customer orders, invoices, credit notes and related documentation
- Maintaining accurate customer and order records within company systems
- Liaising with internal technical teams to resolve customer queries efficiently
- Building strong relationships with customers and business partners across international markets

Candidate Profile
- Native level German or fluency in German and English
- Previous commercial sales or customer service experience
- The ability to communicate technical information clearly and professionally
- Previous customer service, sales support, service advisor or technical support experience
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
- A proactive and customer-focused approach

Salary and Benefits
- 30,000, Monthly performance-related bonus, Full training and ongoing professional development,32 days annual leave including public holidays, Excellent long-term career progression opportunities, Access to on-site gym facilities, Regular company events, team-building activities and employee recognition programmes,Friendly, collaborative working environment in a beautiful countryside location

How to Apply

If you are a German speaking professional looking to develop your career in a customer-focused commercial role, we would be delighted to hear from you.

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Job Role: Sales Advisor

Location: Chesterfield

Salary: 32,000 - 35,000 + Bonus

Are you passionate about sales and customer service? This is an exciting new opportunity with our client, who is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Sales Advisor to join their team in Chesterfield!

Role Overview:

As a Sales Advisor, you will play a crucial role in winning and retaining business. Your primary responsibilities will include quoting and booking calls, following up on open quotes the same day, and working through structured calling lists. You will engage with lapsed accounts, follow up with online enquiries, and new prospects to generate demand and close deals.

Key Responsibilities:
- Quote and book in customer calls
- Handle pricing inquiries confidently.
- Chase open quotes the same day to ensure timely shipping.
- Record outcomes of each follow-up accurately, maintaining detailed notes
- Utilise weekly lists of lapsed accounts, online searchers, and new prospects
- Efficiently serve trade counter collections and ensure daily collections are prepared in advance.
- Managing existing customer accounts, identifying growth opportunities
- Building strong working relationships with customers
- Manage the shared inbox and allocate online orders to meet daily standards.

Key Skills and Experience:
- Natural sales ability on the phone, with a willingness to learn.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in order processing.
- Excellent organisational skills, ensuring tasks are completed and notes are kept.
- Proficiency in office systems
- Team-oriented mindset

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of an organisation that offers a supportive environment where team collaboration is encouraged! If you have a passion for sales and a desire to make an impact, this position is for you!

This is a full time, office based permanent opportunity working Monday to Friday 8:00am - 4:00pm or 9:00am - 5:00pm and one in every four Saturdays 9:00am - 1:00pm.

Adecco is a disability- confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.
